title.narrative: VNM NTP - Viet Nam (01-Jul-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Viet Nam, Tuberculosis, Viet Nam National Lung Hospital (NTP)This program has the following goals: By 2020 reduce the TB morality rate to less than 10 deaths per 100,000 population. By 2020 reduce the TB prevalence rate in the community to 131 cases per 100,000 population. Keep MDR TB prevalence under 5% in new patients. The objectives of this program are: Ensure good health information and M&E in support of NTP management and policy development. Increase TB case detection by intensified and active case finding in risk groups, universal access to high quality services and linking with non NTP public and private providers. Scale-up access to diagnosis and treatment of MDR and XDR TB
